scenario: The ego vehicle is driving straight on a multi-lane city road when a black sedan cuts sharply into its lane from the right, causing a side-impact collision.

ego.behavior: The car travels straight forward in its lane and is struck on its right side by an encroaching vehicle.

adversarials.behavior: The black sedan cuts sharply from the right lane into the ego vehicle's lane to drive around a stationary vehicle blocking its path.
The stationary vehicle remains stopped in the right lane, blocking the path of the black sedan.
The silver car travels straight forward in the left lane, passing the scene of the collision.

spatial_relation: The ego vehicle is in the center lane of a multi-lane city road, with a black sedan initially positioned in the right lane to its right, a stationary vehicle stopped ahead in the right lane, and a silver car in the left lane.
requirements_and_restrictions: The scenario involves a sudden side-impact collision initiated by the black sedan's lane change; the scenario terminates after the collision occurs and vehicles begin to separate.

road_side_structures.position: Positioned on the right side of the road, visible above the black sedan after it cuts into the ego lane.

reasoning_chain: 1. Actors: The ego is the camera-host vehicle from the first-person dashboard perspective. Three adversarials exist: the black sedan, the stationary vehicle, and the silver car in the left lane. 2. Chronology: Initially, ego proceeds straight with a truck ahead and the black sedan to the right. At midpoint, the black sedan swerves left into the ego lane to avoid the stationary vehicle. At ending, side-impact collision occurs between ego and black sedan. 3. Evidence: The black sedan's lateral position shifts from right lane to ego lane; the stationary vehicle remains fixed ahead in the right lane; the silver car maintains constant position in left lane throughout.
